text:
maria: Hey team  noticed two charges for the airport lounge today on the corp card: both $34.00 at 10:12 and 10:13 from "GlobalLounge". I only swiped once. Can you help? cc @finance
ryan: thanks for flagging. Did you get a receipt from the lounge? Sometimes the terminal double-posts but bank usually reverses one charge automatically within 3-5 business days.
maria: I have the single receipt from the lounge (photo attached) and the card statement showing the duplicate. Posted both to Expensify but wanted to ping here since it's on the corporate card.
sam.f: thanks Maria. For duplicates on the corp card we do two things: (1) file a dispute with the card provider (we need the merchant receipt + statement), and (2) if the duplicate charge is not reversed within 7 business days we may issue a temporary manual correction so your card limits aren't impacted. Please confirm you did not personally pay for one of the charges.
maria: confirmed I didn't use a personal card, both on the corp card tail 1234.
cardops-bot: Dispute created: CARD-DISPUTE-7891 for merchant GlobalLounge, amount 34.00 USD, filed by sam.f. Please provide merchant receipt and any supplemental proof.
sam.f: Got the receipt in Expensify. I've attached it to the dispute and queued the chargeback request. Finance will monitor and update this thread.
ryan: If the dispute takes longer than 7 business days mark it as "temporary credit" and cc me; I'll approve a ledger adjustment so the cardholder's available limit isn't reduced.
maria: one more wrinkle  the lounge attendant also gave me a printed stub that just says "access" with no amount (they printed it after the swipe). I uploaded that plus the photo of the terminal screen.
sam.f: that's fine  thanks. We have enough to substantiate. I'll also request the merchant transaction logs from the processor if needed.
expense-bot: Finance note added to EXP-CORP-LOGS: duplicate lounge charge under review, dispute filed (CARD-DISPUTE-7891), attachments: statement.png, lounge-receipt.jpg, terminal-scan.pdf.
cardops-bot: Update: acquirer responded  one charge reversed (10:58 UTC). Remaining charge  34.00 USD  stands. Dispute resolved.
sam.f: Great, looks like bank reversed the duplicate. No further action required. Closing dispute. Maria, please confirm your corp card available limit looks normal.
maria: confirmed, limit restored. Thanks for the quick follow-up everyone! :raised_hands:
ryan: Nice, thanks for flagging this quickly. Reassigning as closed.
